title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
summary: OpenAI clarified its annualized revenue run rate is about $50 billion net—not the $70 billion gross figure widely cited—marking a significant downward revision to AI infrastructure demand expectations. Nvidia fell roughly 3%, Oracle dropped about 6%, Intel fell around 5%, and CoreWeave also declined as markets reassessed AI capex justification.
why: OpenAI是AI芯片/云算力需求的核心锚点，收入口径从$70B调至$50B净值令市场重新评估AI资本开支的合理性。组合中英伟达(NVDA)受直接冲击，covered call溢价可能上升值得关注；同时为持有的科技类sell put头寸的delta风险敲警钟。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq fall for second day in a row as AI trade takes a hit
summary: The Nasdaq fell 1.25% to 27,193, the S&P 500 dropped 0.47% to 7,765, while the Dow Jones edged up 0.10% to 51,231 on October 8. AI and semiconductor stocks led losses following the OpenAI revenue revision; oil briefly spiked above $102 on tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz; the 10-year Treasury yield hovered near 5.35%.
why: 美股二连跌，科技/AI板块受OpenAI收入下修+油价冲击+高债息三重压制，是对组合中英伟达、谷歌、英特尔等仓位影响最直接的日线数据。相较OpenAI专项条目，本条补充道指正收益、S&P收盘点位及油价冲击因子，信息增量明确。

title: Treasury yields: U.S. 10-year hits 5.35% intraday ahead of 30-year bond auction
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield reached an intraday high of 5.35%—the highest level since approximately 2002—before pulling back to around 5.24% after a 30-year bond auction. The 30-year yield also approached near-24-year highs around 5.60%. Fed officials' remarks during the session helped temper the rise.
why: 10年期利率5.35%超越已收录2026-10-07条目的5.27%，本条补充盘中新高及30年期拍卖这一增量信息；高利率持续压制成长股估值倍数，对sell put策略安全垫（远离行权价空间）与期权隐含波动率均有影响。
